overview.location: Dorval, Quebec, on the Island of Montreal, about 20 km (12 mi) west of downtown Montreal
overview.passengerVolume: Canada's third-busiest airport (about 22 million passengers a year) (verify)
overview.terminalsNote: One terminal with three sectors: domestic (Canada), transborder (U.S.) and international (verify gate numbering)
overview.metroAccess: STM 747 express bus between YUL and downtown (Lionel-Groulx metro and René-Lévesque Blvd stops), 24/7 (fare about C$11 (verify)); REM light-rail airport station not yet open (verify)

Return pickup at Gate 9, Departure Level.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: free shuttles from P4, P10 and AéroParc A1 (about 15 min, all hours) to the terminal (verify); short-term, HotelParc and ValetParc are at the terminal. Off-site (Triply): Eyepark Airport valet with a 24/7 shuttle every 15 min; Quality Hotel Montreal Airport every 30 min 5 AM-11 PM and on demand overnight; Baymont Inn every 30 min 4-8:30 AM then hourly 9:15 AM-3:15 AM; Autoparc RM and AutoParc Prime on demand 6:15 AM-11:30 PM only (Autoparc RM lot locked midnight-6 AM). Off-site return pickups are at the Departure Level (Door/Gate 8 or 9).
distanceFromCity: About 20 km (12 mi) west of downtown Montreal; 20-45 min by car depending on Autoroute 20/Turcot traffic; 45-70 min by STM 747 bus. (verify)

peakTravelTimes.note: Terminal approach congestion 3-8 PM daily (Quality Hotel listing); Express drop-off busiest 1-8 PM (La Presse). Peaks around March break, the Quebec construction holiday (late July) and Christmas (verify).

weatherPatterns.note: Snow from about November to April. Baymont Inn does not clear snow from parked cars; covered P4/HotelParc avoid snow clearing. (verify)
